outcome: Diagnosis of transient tachypnea of the newborn
cohort: 101 newborns born to mothers infected with SARS-CoV-2 and 101 newborns born before the pandemic (control group)
finding: Infants born to SARS-CoV-2-positive mothers had a higher likelihood of experiencing moderate respiratory failure compared to infants born to mothers without SARS-CoV-2 infection.
mod_finding: Newborns of SARS-CoV-2-positive mothers were more likely to be delivered by cesarean section and transient tachypnea of the newborn was not correlated with mode of delivery.
